Hey there! Hope you're doing well. I just wanted to chat about a hobby I've been really into lately - it's calligraphy! 📝✨ I've always been drawn to the elegance and artistry of beautifully written words, and it's been so rewarding to dive into this craft.

I've been taking online classes to learn the basics, and it's been a blast. There's something so soothing about the process of carefully dipping a quill into ink and watching the letters come to life. I'm still pretty much a beginner
